snippet.title: Pao Pao Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
In Pao Pao, players run a quirky eatery, juggling cooking, serving, and managing while exploring a lively semi-open world. Whether going solo or teaming up with up to four friends, each gameplay session is filled with chaos, charming NPCs, fun mini-games, and unpredictable surprises. This trailer reveals new gameplay, as revealed in the 2025 Convergence Games Showcase

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024130
